messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@novushealth.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II and supplemental artifacts

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team is kicking off the procurement review for the pilot and they asked for a copy of your latest SOC 2 Type II report and a few supplemental artifacts outside the report so they can validate operational controls. Specifically they asked for: 

- Enforcement evidence for MFA (policy + sample configuration and enforcement metrics)
- A slice of authentication logs covering 2026-05-01 to 2026-07-31 (successful/failed auth events, anonymized user IDs ok)
- Results of the most recent privileged access review (Q2 2026)
- A bridge letter if the SOC 2 report period doesn't cover June/July activities

We can accept redacted or hashed identifiers; we just need enough detail to verify control operation and timelines. Also attaching a quick SIG-lite questionnaire that will help speed handoff (see attached).

Can you confirm what you can provide and an estimated delivery date? We are aiming for a compliance readout with procurement by 8/20.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Security Operations
Novus Health

[Attachment: sig_lite_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and supplemental artifacts

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. We have a SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2026-06-30; I will attach the report and a short bridge letter that explains coverage for July. For the supplemental pieces you listed:

- MFA enforcement: Ben will pull a configuration snapshot plus enforcement metrics (6/1–7/31).
- Auth log slice: Ben/Laura will extract a CSV slice with time, outcome, anonymized user hash, IP (first three octets redacted), and MFA flag for the requested window.
- Privileged access review: Laura will attach the Q2 review artifact and summarize any exceptions.

We will redact PII and hash user identifiers per our standard practice. I expect the artifacts to be ready by EOD 8/12; if anything changes we’ll flag it immediately.

Deliverables plan: SOC2 report + bridge letter (today), MFA config & metrics (8/12), auth log slice (8/12), access review doc (8/12). We will upload to a shared Drive folder and send the link.

If Novus needs a data handling addendum or a short mutual NDA for the auth logs, let me know.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_soc2_typeII_20260630.pdf (pdf)]

Tessa —

Working on the extracts. Notes/constraints:

- MFA config snapshot: I exported the auth provider configuration (timestamps, enabled factors, enforcement rules) as a CSV. See mfa_config_snapshot_202608.csv.
- Auth log slice: I can produce the CSV slice for 2026-05-01→2026-07-31 with the following columns: event_time (UTC), event_type (signin/mfa_challenge), result (success/fail), user_hash (sha256), source_ip_redacted, mfa_used (true/false), session_id_hash. - Access review: The Q2 reviewer notes and e-sign export are attached as access_review_2026Q2.pdf; there are two documented exceptions that we documented and remediated (see page 2).

I’ll upload the artifacts to a restricted Drive folder and share the link with a time-limited viewer link. If Novus requires a different format (e.g., parquet), tell me and I’ll convert.

Ben
